reason: A DeepSeek Harness reminder plugin that monitors task completion and approval-request events and presents configurable cross-window browser notifications without changing core task behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨窗口任务完成和审批请求提醒，并支持点击返回会话及通知设置。
summaries.en: Provides cross-window reminders for DeepSeek Harness task completion and approval requests, with click-to-return navigation and configurable notification settings.

capabilities: Shows browser notifications for task completion and approval requests
Focuses the DeepSeek Harness window and opens the relevant session when clicked
Provides configurable reminder settings and optional notification sounds
